featureReviews.notes: One bench wood for every member (all prisms with grain along v), steel, iron, bark and end grain; colour clusters line up with the reference's (gate max dE 17.9).
Unchanged: toothed blade, hub, nut, slot; spin pivot proven by the pose render.
Legs, stretchers and braces are now chamfered prisms: their softened edges read closer to the reference's timbers than the old sharp boxes.
Unchanged: log on the top turned toward the viewer, pale ringed cut face.

summary: Optimization pass: frame members rebuilt as chamfered extruded prisms (28 triangles each instead of 192-triangle subdivided boxes) and one bench wood material: 4152 -> 1856 triangles, 25 meshes, 6 materials. The game build merges static parts per material and keeps the blade and the log live. Tier-1 IoU 0.874, aspect 0.035, scale 0.023, colour max dE 17.9; orbit, self-intersection and attachment gates pass.
mismatches: grain subtler than the reference's painted grain
notes: Viewed renders/optimization-pass/cmp.jpg and turntable.jpg; posed renders (blade +0.55 rad, log +0.1) re-captured in this pass.
